chain.title: Blood Altar
chain.desc: Place the Blood Altar with room for the larger tier structures around it. Its stored Life Essence powers altar recipes; your Soul Network is a separate reserve, so learn to check both.

chain.title: Sacrificial Knife
chain.desc: Use the Sacrificial Knife near the altar to supply its first Life Essence. Keep food and healing ready, and stop before low health turns routine crafting into a death.

chain.title: Hellfire Forge
chain.desc: Build the Hellfire Forge for Demon Will crafting. Unlike the altar, it uses Will and Tartaric Gems; keep those resources separate from your LP equipment.

chain.title: Weak Blood Orb
chain.desc: Transmute the first Blood Orb in the altar, bind it to yourself and read your Soul Network with the Divination Sigil once available. The orb is a reusable crafting and network tool, not fuel to replace after every recipe.

chain.title: Blank Slate
chain.desc: Keep the altar supplied while it turns stone into Blank Slates. Make a small reserve for runes, sigils and machines before moving on to higher slate tiers.

chain.title: Soul Snare
chain.desc: Throw a Soul Snare at a hostile creature until it shows the effect, then defeat it to collect Demon Will. This starts the separate Hellfire Forge branch.

chain.title: Alchemy Table
chain.desc: Supply the Alchemy Table with a bound Blood Orb and the recipe ingredients. This branch produces ashes and reagents for sigils and Living Armour while the altar develops in parallel.

chain.title: Blank Rune
chain.desc: Use Blood Runes to build the Tier 2 altar structure from the guide's diagram. Confirm the new tier with the Divination Sigil before attempting the next orb or slate.

chain.title: A Different Kind of Power
chain.desc: Collect Demon Will from a creature marked by a Soul Snare. Keep it for the first Tartaric Gem and forge recipes; it is separate from the altar's Life Essence.

chain.title: Divination Sigil
chain.desc: Use the Divination Sigil to inspect an altar and your Soul Network. Check the displayed tier and available LP before an expensive infusion rather than guessing from the altar's appearance.

chain.title: Petty Tartaric Gem
chain.desc: First Hellfire Forge recipe; stores 64 Demon Will and vacuums up loose Will dropped on the ground.

chain.title: Apprentice Blood Orb
chain.desc: Complete the Tier 2 altar and prepare enough LP for the Apprentice Blood Orb. The larger network capacity supports the next range of alchemy and sigil recipes.

chain.title: Dagger of Sacrifice
chain.desc: Use the Dagger of Sacrifice on suitable creatures close to the altar to supply LP. This is a separate altar-fuelling route; it does not replace Demon Will collection for the Hellfire Forge.

chain.title: The Second Slate Tier
chain.desc: Upgrade Blank Slates in a Tier 2 altar. These slates support the next altar structure and a new set of sigil recipes.

chain.title: Sentient Sword
chain.desc: Forge a Sentient Sword and carry a Tartaric Gem while fighting. This replaces repeated Soul Snare use with a steadier way to gather the Will your forge recipes need.

chain.title: Magician's Blood Orb
chain.desc: Build the guide's Tier 3 altar layout and verify its tier before making this orb. Prepare the altar's capacity and refill rate so the infusion does not stall halfway through.

chain.title: Master Ritual Stone
chain.desc: Choose a ritual in the guide, prepare its Ritual Stones and centre the layout on the Master Ritual Stone. The Ritual Diviner handles the arrangement; a bound Activation Crystal starts the finished ritual.

chain.title: Living Chestplate
chain.desc: Create Living Armour using the binding array described in the guide. Wear it while carrying out normal activities, then inspect the upgrades you earn and their shared upgrade-point budget.

chain.title: The Third Slate Tier
chain.desc: Upgrade Reinforced Slates in the Tier 3 altar. Reserve Imbued Slates for the ARC and the ritual equipment that connects your workshop to the Demon Realm.

chain.title: Plan the Ritual
chain.desc: Select the intended ritual with the Ritual Diviner and supply its required stones. Use the guide's layout and activation instructions before you spend LP on the ritual.

chain.title: Wake the Stones
chain.desc: Bind the Weak Activation Crystal and use it on a completed ritual's Master Ritual Stone. Check the ritual's startup and running LP costs first.

chain.title: Demon Realm
chain.desc: Build and activate the Edge of the Hidden Realm ritual to reach the Demon Realm entrance. Bring supplies and a return plan; deeper dungeon routes provide resources needed by the later altar tiers.

chain.title: Alchemical Reaction Chamber
chain.desc: Set up the Alchemical Reaction Chamber with the correct tool and recipe ingredients. Its processing routes connect the dungeon crops to the materials for your next altar upgrade.

chain.title: Tau Fruit
chain.desc: Bring Tau Fruit home from the Demon Realm and grow it in a controlled area. The saturated crop is part of the route to Weak Blood Shards, so follow its special growth instructions rather than harvesting every plant immediately.

chain.title: Intricate Hellforged Parts
chain.desc: Recover Intricate Hellforged Parts from the deeper Demon Realm. Use them in the listed rune upgrades to improve an altar you already rely on rather than rebuilding the entire structure at once.

chain.title: Weak Blood Shard
chain.desc: Process the required saturated Tau material in the ARC with its listed tool. Save Weak Blood Shards for the Tier 4 altar and Master Blood Orb before using the first supply on optional equipment.

chain.title: Master Blood Orb
chain.desc: Complete the Tier 4 altar and infuse a Weak Blood Shard into the Master Blood Orb. Verify the structure and capacity first; the new network supports much larger ritual projects.

chain.title: Archmage's Blood Orb
chain.desc: Explore the deeper Demon Realm routes for the Hellforged materials used by this orb. Prepare the altar recipe shown in the installed guide; dungeon progression and your LP workshop meet at this final network upgrade.

chain.title: The Fourth Slate Tier
chain.desc: Upgrade Imbued Slates in a Tier 4 altar. Demonic Slates open the next tier of ritual tools and advanced equipment.

chain.title: Ritual Diviner [Dusk]
chain.desc: Upgrade the basic Diviner with Demonic Slates and two Dusk Inscription Tools (2,000 LP each at a Tier 4 altar) to build the advanced rituals - Well of Suffering, Living Evolution, the meteor ritual and the deep-realm gateway.

notes: Reviewed against the primary sources listed above. Every chain row now declares its intended prerequisites; an empty list is an intentional independent starting point. The order is topological. Item and checkpoint-icon asset paths and typed objective identifiers were checked against the listed jar or source snapshot. Jar inspection verifies identifiers and selected mechanics, not that every route has been completed in game.

sources.scope: English guide/tooltip text, recipe data and inventory assets; selected special mechanics checked against implementation.

coverage.scope: Altar tiers, LP and Soul Network, Will equipment, alchemy, rituals and Demon Realm materials.
coverage.limits: A curated teaching route, not every item or mechanic. Recipe quantities and conditions follow the installed pack. Manual checkpoints require player confirmation. No complete in-game playthrough claimed.
